title: RECOVERY · MOVE WELL
emphasis: Baseline plan. Tell your coach what you actually completed.

ignition.name: Steady treadmill or outdoor walk
ignition.cue: Keep a pace that lets you speak complete sentences.
ignition.prescription: 1 min easy continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.
ignition.home: 1 min easy continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.

deposits.title: MOBILITY

exercises.name: Wall slides + open-book rotation
exercises.cue: Keep ribs relaxed and shoulders comfortable. Stop if painful.
exercises.prescription: Alternate gentle wall slides and side-lying open-book rotations. Split the allotted time equally; turn both ways without forcing range. Demo unavailable.
exercises.home: Alternate gentle wall slides and side-lying open-book rotations. Split the allotted time equally; turn both ways without forcing range. Demo unavailable.
exercises.away: Use the same comfortable unloaded movements, with a wall or chair for support.

deposits.effort: Comfortable active range; stop anything painful. No forced stretching.
deposits.label: B

levels.bonus: Optional brisk walk; dummy lab separate

weekSummary: Mon strength A · Tue endurance · Wed strength B · Thu endurance · Fri strength C · Sat boxing · Sun recovery

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · ARM-DRAG CONNECTION
martialSupplement.home: Review a familiar arm-drag sequence slowly with the dummy, or study your trusted reference. Pause after the arm clears; inspect angle and connection. Up to 3 slow reps/side. Focus: Can I keep a useful connection after the drag without pulling harder?
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same familiar positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: Weekly question: can I keep posture and connection consistent while changing position?
martialSupplement.text: Optional 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
